title: KPI Signal Multiplexer and Cardinality Scrub Gateway
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Build a tenant-aware multiplexer gateway that ingests heterogeneous metric signals (OTLP metrics, Prometheus scrape push/remote_write, and light-weight agent envelopes), performs de-duplication and cardinality scrubbing, attaches tracing hooks for causal linkage, and emits a canonical KPI envelope for downstream SLO rollups, billing attribution, and dashboards.
background: We currently receive metric signals from multiple sources (agent sidecars, runtime exporters, and cluster scrapes). Inconsistent labels, high-cardinality keys from customer payloads, and duplicated samples are inflating storage costs and destabilizing per-model latency SLA calculations. Previous ad-hoc fixes (sidecar label filters and tenant sampling) are brittle. This gateway centralizes signal normalization and enforces tenant-level contracts before metrics enter the long-term pipeline.
goals: Accept OTLP metric streams and Prometheus remote_write with a unified ingest API
Deterministically deduplicate samples across upstream producers within a tenant window
Apply cardinality scrub rules per tenant (configurable allow/deny lists and hash-binning for unknown labels)
Enrich metrics with trace/span anchors for causal latency attribution
Emit canonical KPI envelopes (SLA-friendly schema) into the metrics bus and a lightweight archive for billing
non_goals: Long-term storage migration (outside scope) - gateway only normalizes and forwards
Replacing existing Prometheus scrapers - we accept their remote_write output
Heavy-weight label rewriting requiring customer code changes
design_decisions: Use an idempotent sample fingerprinting scheme (tenant_id + metric_name + series_hash + timestamp-quantize) to dedupe
Expose tenant scrub policies via a simple JSON contract stored in config-store (feature flags for rollout)
Prefer lightweight hash-binning for unknown label values (bucketized pseudonymization) instead of dropping to preserve SLI shape
Enrich via trace correlation by consuming a small trace index (span id -> request anchor) from the trace hooks service instead of blocking on synchronous RPCs
Implement rate-limited backpressure and buffered retry for remote_write sinks to avoid data loss during downstream incidents
progress_updates: 2026-02-22: Spike completed comparing sample fingerprint algorithms (murmur3 vs siphash). Chose siphash for collision resistance and performance.
2026-03-01: Prototype gateway that accepts OTLP and prometheus remote_write; basic dedupe pass-through verified against resident test harness (local load 5k req/s).
2026-03-04: PM review with Ellen Park — asked for explicit billing envelope fields (route, token_id, token_tier). Added to output schema.
2026-03-07: Design review: security team requested encryption-at-rest for temporary buffers and a security checklist item added.
2026-03-10: Integration test failed on high-cardinality model label (generated token_id); added hash-binning fallback and re-ran tests — success.

2026-03-12: Began end-to-end test with staging traces: trace link enrichment validated for 92% of requests; missing anchors traced to sampling mismatch between trace service and agent. Next: align sampling windows.
acceptance_criteria: Gateway accepts OTLP/Otel metrics and Prometheus remote_write input formats and emits canonical KPI envelope to metrics bus
Deduplication reduces duplicate ingestion rate by >= 70% on synthetic duplicate workload
Per-tenant cardinality scrub rules apply and unknown label hash-binning keeps distinct value explosion below tenant threshold
Trace enrichment attaches span anchors for >= 90% of qualifying inference requests in staging
No regression in existing production dashboards when gateway is enabled in a canary tenant (observability runbook validated)
Security checklist items completed: buffer encryption, RBAC for policy updates, and audit log entries for scrub policy changes
tasks: Cardinality scrub policy evaluator + config-store integration (Aisha)
Trace anchor consumer and enrichment joiner (Lei)
Output adapter to metrics bus + remote_write sink with backpressure (Marco)
End-to-end integration tests and synthetic duplicate workloads (QA - Priya)
Canary rollout plan and dashboard smoke-tests (SRE - Daniel)
dependencies: ENG-912345 (sidecar conditional metric enrichment) - opt-in header contract
infra-keys-kms-2026 (secrets/KMS access) - required for buffer encryption
notes: Trade-off: full label redaction provides strongest privacy but breaks SLI shape. Chose hash-binning with tenant threshold to preserve signal for SLO analysis.
Rollout: feature-flag per-tenant; initial canary to internal tenants with observed heavy duplication.
Open question: whether to surface scrub policy suggestions in Console Optimize - deferred to product cycle 2026-W15.
